delivery.outcome: Replace the obsolete four-list autonomous-merge description with the deployed single-registry, repository-scoped App and PAT-isolated runtime contract, then use this ticket PR as a schedule-only merge canary.
nonGoals: Do not change merge rule semantics or Env DSL equations
Do not edit validator-agent from this target ticket
Do not use workflow_dispatch or an interactive merge for the canary PR
Do not absorb untracked drafts from another checkout

architecture.decision: Document the protected validator registry as the only repository membership and check-policy source, and require a real schedule event as publication evidence.
architecture.rollback: Before merge, close the canary PR and retain its branch; after merge, restore the previous prose only through a new reviewed integration ticket.

commands: gh run list --repo subactor/validator-agent --workflow validator.yml --event schedule
